reply.text: Knee sleeves are gear, not something that stops you squatting, so yes, you can squat without them. Whether a lift feels right without support depends on how your knees feel under load, and I'd rather you judge that from a few light sets than take my word for it. Warm up thoroughly, start your working weights a bit lighter than you'd use with sleeves, and see how it goes. If you get any pain or discomfort in the knee itself, that one is for a doctor or physio, not me, and I'll keep building the training around whatever they clear.
